outcome: severe histological placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) subtypes
cohort: The study included 100 women with a mean age of 34.6 years who had MRI performed for suspicion of PAS from ultrasound, clinical findings of PAS at laparotomy, and/or histopathological confirmation.
finding: The study validated a previous model and developed a new clinical-radiomic model, incorporating radiomic features from T2-weighted MRI and the number of previous caesareans, which demonstrated good predictive potential (AUC of 0.713) for identifying severe placenta increta.
mod_finding: The number of previous caesareans was identified as a significant clinical variable, improving the prediction performance of the new multivariate radiomic model for placenta increta.
